dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, blacksmithing is a great workout.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I've visited Xilonen's workshop a bunch of times whenever I need to commission some custom equipment... Always wanted to try my hand at hammering something, but she never let me.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: But since you have a whole setup here... Would it be alright if I used it? That way, I can try out any new ideas I have as soon as they pop into my head.
